summary: Round 43 plan check (ops lens, 0 Kaggle calls, 16:14-16:30Z). The evening chain is armed and consistent with decision B: mk_card_1837.py sha8 a19e1bd6, r43_dry 35/35 ok, one t7_trigger (16748), one manual_admit (3028), both exp89t waiters alive, all timers alive, pre_exp89t/old t7/old watchdog gone, on AC (67%), idle sleep disabled. Found 4 ops gaps from the 15:59Z restart. (1) The re-armed watchdog (5024) counts error headers as fresh, so a network loss like 15:19-15:43Z never trips it. (2) The old jobs are orphans: manual_admit and the old exp89t watcher write to task files the new session never gets notified about. (3) The waiters skip '[empty stdout' blocks that carry retry data, so a waiter can report a later header than the first terminal one; --hdr needs a first-terminal one-liner. (4) The R41-A5 census PID list for the 17:13Z round is stale. Also: the poller cadence is ~10 min, not 5. Predicted headers: ~18:15/18:25/18:35Z; T7 ~19:15:35Z (22:15 MSK); last pre-edge header ~19:35:40Z, next ~19:45:42Z (after the edge), so manual-admit is likely to fire. The card rank line still defaults to #141/3 994 labelled 14:45 МСК.

findings.what: The watchdog re-armed at 16:09Z (win 5024) is blind to a network loss. It takes the age of the newest '===' header INCLUDING '[empty stdout ...' error headers, and the poller writes such a header every ~11.5 min while offline (15:19:43Z, 15:31:24Z, 15:43:04Z), so 'POLL STALE' never fires. The watchdog is also one-shot: the 15:08Z battery alert ended the previous one before the drop, which is why round 42 died unnoticed.

findings.what: The --hdr for the exp89t card and message must be the FIRST poll.log header that shows 56669888 terminal (R41-A3). The new waiter (29828) and t7_trigger use lastok, which skips blocks whose header carries '[empty stdout', even when a retry inside the same poll() returned data. The poller stamps the header before the call and appends the notes from failed attempts, so such a block carries the first terminal status under an earlier header. The waiter then prints the NEXT clean header, about 10 min later. Near the 19:12:17Z or 19:45:17Z edges this flips T1<->T2 or T2/T3KEEP/T5 -> T8.
findings.evidence: experiments/lb_poll/lb_poll.py: ts is taken before poll(); poll() retries 3x with sleep 30 and returns the stdout with the accumulated notes, and the header is f'=== {ts}{note}'. lastok.sh: ok=($0 !~ /\[empty stdout/). Process 29828: until lastok | grep -qE '^56669888,.*(COMPLETE|ERROR)'.
findings.action: When the waiter fires, take --hdr from this 0-call one-liner, not from the waiter's echo: awk '/^=== /{h=substr($0,5,20)} /^56669888,.*SubmissionStatus\.(COMPLETE|ERROR)/{print h; exit}' experiments/lb_poll/poll.log. If it differs from the waiter's header, use the awk header, recompute --lhi from it and log both.
